scope: Public dataset-card research only. No dataset rows copied, downloaded, or bundled; no gated terms accepted. Metadata records card claims rather than a rights audit.

sources.access_observation: Gated; includes a non-commercial-use checkbox in addition to the license metadata. Resolve these terms before any data reuse.
sources.quality_observation: English social-media posts differ from room descriptions; label definitions and annotation agreement need inspection before transfer.
sources.mapping_observation: The broad sex/profanity labels do not identify specific room concepts; independent room-taxonomy annotation is required.

sources.access_observation: Card was readable; data access conditions not separately verified.
sources.quality_observation: Card describes scraped and aggregated text, much of it scene/image descriptions. It removes numbers, punctuation and other signals during preprocessing; source lineage and duplicates need review.
sources.mapping_observation: A binary NSFW label is not a multi-axis room-taxonomy assignment or a separate policy outcome.

sources.access_observation: Card was readable; specific reuse terms were not established from the card.
design_ideas: Labeled text paired with explicit categories
sources.quality_observation: Card describes 850 English article descriptions scraped from different platforms, with limited annotation/provenance detail.
sources.mapping_observation: Adult/Non_Adult labels require reannotation for specific room concepts; neither class should be blindly mapped to the content root.

sources.access_observation: Card includes a moderation-training intended-use statement; inspect this and upstream terms before any reuse.
design_ideas: Document upstream datasets and distinguish tasks
sources.quality_observation: Derived from moderation evaluation data and WELFake; its mixed tasks and label types require careful interpretation.
sources.mapping_observation: Moderation and policy labels stay separate from room taxonomy. No policy examples or rows are imported here.
